ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote until the pull request is approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), NOT(copado__Pull_Requests_Approved__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The pull request is not approved yet. Pull Requests Approved must be checked before ticking Ready to Promote.
